```yaml
name: Secrets Diagnostics
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  secrets-diagnostics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          go mod download
          go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@latest

      - name: Run Linters
        run: |
          golangci-lint run ./...

      - name: Build
        run: |
          go build -o gh-aw .

      - name: Test
        run: |
          go test -v ./...

      - name: Validate Token Fallback Chain
        run: |
          echo "Validating token fallback chain implementation..."
          # Check that token fallback logic is properly implemented
          if grep -r "GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN.*GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN.*GITHUB_TOKEN" . --include="*.go"; then
            echo "✓ Token fallback chain found in source code"
          else
            echo "✗ Token fallback chain not found in source code"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Verify that all relevant files have been updated
          FILES_TO_CHECK=(
            "safe_outputs_steps.go"
            "safe_outputs_env.go"
            "copilot_participant_steps.go"
            "create_issue.go"
          )
          
          for file in "${FILES_TO_CHECK[@]}"; do
            if [ -f "$file" ]; then
              echo "✓ $file exists"
            else
              echo "✗ $file does not exist"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Validate Lock File
        run: |
          echo "Validating campaign-generator.lock.yml..."
          if [ -f "campaign-generator.lock.yml" ]; then
            echo "✓ campaign-generator.lock.yml exists"
            # Check for fallback chain usage in lock file
            if grep -q "GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN\|GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN\|GITHUB_TOKEN" campaign-generator.lock.yml; then
              echo "✓ Token fallback chain found in lock file"
            else
              echo "✗ Token fallback chain not found in lock file"
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            echo "✗ campaign-generator.lock.yml does not exist"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Report Success
        if: success()
        run: |
          echo "✓ All diagnostics passed - token fallback chain is properly implemented"
```
